node.statement: Second term. Apply lem-hcb0-compressed-associator by its exact registered name to the compatible amplified triple Z,W,X: ||T_2||<=C_as*e||Z||||W||||X||. Preliminary control (ii), first on T_2 in the P,Q column and then on X in the R,Q column, gives q_P(T_2)<=K||T_2||<=C_as*K^2*e||Z||||W||q_R(X). No associativity is assumed; this is precisely the permitted associator estimate.
